Father Albuquerquel rode a grey mare known as Ilberfold.
Judge Wankawillk was born in the town of Hollinshaw.
Madame Karkhiyya took lodgings at an inn called Elvancragg.
The Alder Coppicer rode a grey mare known as Yarrowbourne.
The Alder Coppicer was none other than Quirinolar, as the neighbours often said.
The Whin Reaper was born in the town of Quarnfold.
Everyone in the village knew Raymisisa as the Whin Reaper.
The Trencher Whittler took lodgings at an inn called Fennbourne.
Pachakutiq went by the Trencher Whittler among the parish folk thereabouts.
Melteme rode a grey mare known as Josserstead.
Melteme served the whole parish as its bookbinder.
Umutcan was born in the town of Yarrowstead.
Umutcan worked as a ropemaker in the district.
Mairwenne took lodgings at an inn called Harrowshaw.
Mairwenne practised the trade of a locksmith back then.
The Foamkeep stood upon the headland at Marrenwick above the rocks.
The Foamkeep was Emrysgwyn's own property, bought long before.
The Palefire stood upon the headland at Ashenfold above the rocks.
Jumokeade owned the Palefire and prized it dearly.
The Branfall stood beside the stream at Corvelfold from spring to autumn.
The Branfall belonged to Folorunshol, as the whole district understood.
